extra_quotes: Both critical paths are measured by ISE’s trce on the routed design.

The open toolchain supports the Spartan-3E boards (Basys2, Nexys2), the Spartan-6 boards (Nexys3, Atlys) and the iCEBreaker; other boards still need ISE through the local server, and further families are planned.
The Spartan-6 flow does not yet cover clock managers’ configurations beyond those measured.
Speed results are below ISE’s at the Fast goal, and the remaining critical-path gap at Speed lies in routing.

The shipped device descriptions are still the ones computed from an ISE report; the measured descriptions of the Spartan-3E dies, which avoid that dependence, pass the same checks but do not yet replace them.
